name: tablet-android
source: Galaxy Tab A8 class (10.5 inch 1920x1200, 8 cores, 4 GB). CSS size assumes 1.5x scaling. Chrome on Android tablets sends a user agent without the Mobile token and userAgentData.mobile false. The 6x CPU slowdown is the DevTools low-tier mobile preset. Adapter vendor and limits are unmeasured; GPU limits are the WebGPU specification default limits (the floor every adapter must meet), not a measurement of this device. User agent follows the shape current Chrome sends (reduced UA); the version number is illustrative.
userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
